Subject: Clarifying SOC 2 retention thresholds for renewal + short-term throughput request

Hi Priyom / Kimberly,

We're in the final stages of our renewal with legal, and two items came up that I need help confirming before we sign:

1) Retention thresholds: Our audit team needs confirmation of the effective retention horizon for system/audit logs and evaluation artifacts. The renewal letter references "up to 36 months" but we need clear mapping by artifact type (audit logs, API request logs, KV cache snapshots, model eval artifacts). Can you provide a short table or bullet list?

2) Evidence handoff bandwidth: We have a ~900GB evidence bundle plus incremental artifacts that will be uploaded during our re-audit window (target window: 31 Aug - 3 Sep). Can Redwood support a temporary throughput/burst to ingest the objects over that 4-day period without throttling? If so, what are the recommended upload endpoints and any quota changes we need to request now?

I've attached a manifest (snapshot_manifest.csv) that shows the artifacts and rough sizes. Also, please flag any items that would require longer-term retention beyond the standard policy.

Quick timeline would be helpful — legal wants confirmation by EOD Fri (28 Aug) so we can proceed with signature and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Park
Director, Compliance Programs
Clearline Financial

Subject: Re: Clarifying SOC 2 retention thresholds for renewal + short-term throughput request

Jenna — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest. We're on it. High level responses below; Ben and Kim are copied to add technical/legal detail.

Retention mapping (summary):
- Audit logs (auth, admin events): default 36 months retained in warm storage; 7 years available in cold archive on request (longer-term retention is a paid add-on).
- API request logs (per-request metadata): 18 months warm, 36 months cold snapshot (default renewal footprint).
- KV cache snapshots & model artifacts (snapshots referenced in manifest): retained for 12 months by default; we can extend to 36 months for renewal-bound customers with a contract amendment.
- Eval artifacts / golden-sets: treated as "customer artifacts" — retention per-customer policy; default 36 months if requested in the amendment.

Temporary throughput: we can provision a burst ingest window. Ben, can you confirm the max sustained ingress we can lift for the 31 Aug–3 Sep window and whether we can offer this as a courtesy for the renewal signature? Also adding Marissa to coordinate commercial (credits/term amendment).

I'll follow up with a short doc that maps the artifact types to storage class and cost delta. If this is urgent for legal, Kim — can you advise on the minimum contractual language we should confirm today (PO/DocuSign / retention addendum)?

Best,
Priyom
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

- Endpoint: s3://redwood-evidence-upload/clearline-CL-2026-RNW. We'll provide signed STS creds and simple multipart upload instructions.
- Quota changes: I will submit the temporary quota increase today; please expect creds + instructions by COB 26 Aug.

Any retention beyond default (e.g., cold-archive >36 months) will require a paid amendment — I'll include rough costs in a follow-up.

- Jenna: confirm target upload dates (if you want me to reserve specific windows).
